en.headline: Worker injured after scaffolding collapses in Sham Shui Po
en.dek: A 69-year-old man was trapped under debris when a section of bamboo scaffolding fell from a building on Nam Cheong Street and was later rescued conscious.
body: A section of bamboo scaffolding collapsed at a building on Nam Cheong Street near Yu Chau Street in Sham Shui Po on Saturday afternoon, trapping a worker underneath.

Firefighters freed the 69-year-old man, who sustained head and back injuries and was taken to hospital conscious. Police classified the case as an industrial accident and the Labour Department said it had begun an investigation.

Scaffolding union representatives said construction materials stored on the working platform may have overloaded the structure, causing supporting bamboo to break. Nearby shop staff and passers-by helped clear debris before emergency services arrived.

zh.headline: 深水埗南昌街棚架倒塌 69歲男工受傷被困獲救
zh.dek: 周六下午南昌街近汝州街唐樓外牆棚架倒塌，一名69歲男工被困瓦礫下，消防救出後清醒送院。
body: 周六下午近4時，深水埗南昌街近汝州街一幢唐樓外牆棚架倒塌，一名工人被困在瓦礫下。
消防將69歲余姓男工救出，他頭部及背部受傷，清醒送往瑪嘉烈醫院。警方列作工業意外，勞工處已展開調查。
搭棚工會初步認為，工作平台存放大量建築物料導致荷載過大，橫竹斷裂倒塌。附近商舖職員及途人曾協助清理雜物。
